name: Nami — Art of Weather
description: Stationary Straw Hat weather artillery, One Piece manga through the end of Wano. Source-backed weather science supplies lightning, Gust Sword, Heat Egg and Raitei. Zeus already resides inside her Sorcery Clima-Tact at placement, not in a standalone summoned body. Generous collision tolerance and purchasable prelaunch retargeting approximate his assistance; true homing, weapon reshaping and consciousness transfer are omitted. Heat Egg canonically forms a hot orb at the staff's end; its scheduled, launched aimed-shot delivery here is an authored limitation/adaptation, not an established projectile feat. Snow melting and terrain interactions are not simulated. Gust Sword displaces eligible displaceable targets without passing the path entrance. Lightning applies no movement slows, stuns or substitute hostile debuffs. All numbers, prices, schedules, unlocks and stamina costs are provisional game tuning, not canon measurements; prices await measured balance. Cadence upgrades abstract practiced weather setup, not speed magic. Stamina represents Technique preparation, not transformation exhaustion. The highest purchased tier on any path unlocks Gust Sword at 1 and replaces it with Raitei at 5 on the single shared Technique button. Purchases are cumulative under the maximum 5-2-0 rule. Enemy movement is caller-supplied. Mirage Tempo, Fata Morgana, Milky Road travel/terrain, showers, Impact Dial absorption/recoil, navigation, theft, negotiation and financial management are omitted. No healing, ally damage buffs, regeneration denial, elemental-immunity bypass or later-arc feats.

paths.name: Thundercloud Output
paths.description: Personal lightning and Technique damage specialization. Heat Egg remains a separate static scheduled attack and receives none of these purchases. Damage scaling is provisional gameplay tuning, not a new power or a claim that Raitei defeats every opponent in one hit. Zeus's Wano integration follows Hera seemingly consuming his former body, the Clima-Tact speaking, and his survival within it being explained. Only the highest unlocked contextual Technique is exposed through the shared button.

upgrades.name: Charged Weather Balls
upgrades.description: Adds 4 damage to the primary and all Techniques. Highest tier 1 also unlocks stamina and Gust Sword.

upgrades.name: Denser Thundercloud
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary and all Technique damage by 1.2 after flat additions.

upgrades.name: Larger Charge Reserve
upgrades.description: Adds another 8 damage to the primary and all Techniques; does not change or refill stamina.

upgrades.name: Concentrated Discharge
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary and all Technique damage by a further 1.3.

upgrades.name: Zeus-Amplified Thunder
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary and all Technique damage by a further 1.45. Highest tier 5 replaces Gust Sword with Raitei through the shared Technique button; Zeus was already present in the weapon.

paths.name: Weather Preparation
paths.description: Improves personal weather-artillery cadence through cumulative primary timing reductions. These authored improvements abstract Nami's practiced Clima-Tact setup and Weatheria knowledge, not navigation-based speed magic or hostile electrical debuffs. Every purchase multiplies both primary windup and period, allowing earlier launches and more frequent primary cycles. Technique timing, shared cooldown, stamina, projectile travel and scheduled Heat Egg remain unchanged. No slows or stuns are granted. Only the highest unlocked contextual Technique is exposed.

upgrades.name: Prepared Heat and Cool Mix
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary windup and period by 0.9. Technique timing is unchanged.

upgrades.name: Practiced Weather Ball Sequence
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary windup and period by a further 0.9, cumulatively reaching 0.81 of base timing. Abstracts faster preparation without applying hostile debuffs.

upgrades.name: Efficient Cloud Assembly
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary windup and period by a further 0.85; does not accelerate Techniques or Heat Egg.

upgrades.name: Streamlined Weather Setup
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary windup and period by a further 0.85, improving launch readiness and sustained firing cadence. Does not change projectile speed or Technique cooldown.

upgrades.name: Weatheria Setup Mastery
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary windup and period by a further 0.8, cumulatively reaching 0.46818 of base timing. Tier 5 supplies Raitei through the shared Technique button; its timing remains unchanged.

paths.name: Cloud Placement
paths.description: Extends personal acquisition reach and improves prelaunch target handling. Reach is an abstract deployment limit for localized weather, not staff length. Zeus-assisted retargeting replaces one lost primary target only before launch; projectiles never home or retarget after launch, and Techniques never retarget. Mirage Tempo and Fata Morgana are omitted optical deception: this encounter has no defensive targeting or evasion, so they grant no fake damage, concealment detection or taunt. Only the highest unlocked contextual Technique is exposed.

upgrades.name: Extended Cloud Placement
upgrades.description: Adds 4 personal reach, taking the unmodified base reach from 40 to 44.

upgrades.name: Zeus Checks the Target
upgrades.description: Enables one replacement for a lost primary target before launch without restarting windup. No postlaunch steering or Technique retargeting.

upgrades.name: Distant Cloud Positioning
upgrades.description: Adds another 6 personal reach, reaching 50 on this path. Does not change Heat Egg range or projectile speed.

upgrades.name: Stable Long-Range Discharge
upgrades.description: Adds 5 personal reach and 5 damage to the primary and all Techniques.

upgrades.name: Far-Reaching Thundercloud
upgrades.description: Adds 5 personal reach, reaching 60 on this path, and multiplies primary and all Technique damage by 1.25. Tier 5 supplies Raitei; its larger collision tolerance remains an aimed-shot abstraction.
